title: Louis Armstrong in the Tuxedo Brass Band
summary: Clark recalls Louis Armstrong playing Panama in the Tuxedo Brass Band and says he knew him all his life but never played with him.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well I remember when Louis Armstrong was here, he was playing in the Tuxedo Brass Band at that time. And they used to play Panama. And he used to make that high note. And they felt like Louis Armstrong was true, I knew Louis all my life. Practically all my life. See, but I never did play with him. See, I never had the opportunity to play with him because I wasn't just up to it. I was just crawling in the manner of speaking.
